# mxroute_email_account (Resource)

Manage a mailbox. Creation and explicit rotation require a write-only password of 8–72 characters and a positive rotation version. Server-specific strength/character requirements still apply. Import requires no password. Delete permanently removes the mailbox and may destroy its mail; system-mailbox restrictions remain live-unverified. No system identity is inferred or automatically managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "mailbox_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "mxroute_email_account" "support" {
  domain              = "example.com"
  username            = "support"
  quota               = 1024 # MB; use 0 for unlimited
  limit               = 120
  password_wo         = var.mailbox_password
  password_wo_version = 1 # increase to rotate
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Owned canonical domain. Reference its resource to order cleanup.
- `username` (String) Mailbox local part. Case-insensitive lookup; casing-only edits do not replace or duplicate the mailbox.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `limit` (Number) Daily send limit, at most 9600. Omission adopts the server value (documented creation default 9600) and preserves it on update; other bounds are server validated.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only password, required on creation and when password_wo_version increases. Read from configuration only; never persisted in plan or state. Omit on updates to preserve the remote credential. Imports do not require a password.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Positive rotation version. Required with password_wo. Increase to rotate; retain the existing version when omitting the password. Imported objects may omit both fields until their first explicit rotation.
- `quota` (Number) Storage quota in MB; 0 means unlimited. Omission adopts the server value (documented creation default 1024 MB), and updates preserve it. Other bounds are server validated.

### Read-Only

- `canonical_username` (String) Canonical server name used for reads, updates and deletion.
- `email` (String) Server-reported email address.
- `id` (String) Account-relative domain/lowercase-local-part identity.
- `sent` (Number) Volatile daily sent count.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Server suspension status; the API has no mailbox suspension write operation.
- `usage` (Number) Volatile mailbox storage usage in MB.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mxroute_email_account.support example.com/support
```
